intersection.headline: Nike's first investor day in nine years: Elliott Hill to set out the turnaround plan
intersection.summary: Nike hosts its first investor day since 2017 on 16-17 November, with CEO Elliott Hill expected to present a new five-year financial framework through fiscal 2031. Analysts want detail on the 'Pace' cost-savings programme, the China business, Converse and stabilising Jordan Brand. Nike has reorganised around vertical sport teams under its 'Sport Offense' model. Both pieces are previews published before the event, so check the outcome once the presentation is out.

fashion.headline: Louis Vuitton unveils Keith Haring collection across bags, knitwear and sculptural shoes
fashion.summary: Louis Vuitton's new collection with the estate of Keith Haring turns his dancing figures and running hearts into bags, knitwear, accessories and shoes with lightbulb-shaped heels. Pieces were first shown at Art Basel Paris in October. The collection pairs street art with luxury craftsmanship. Marie Claire Australia is not a listed source and I could not find Louis Vuitton's own announcement, so treat this as lower-confidence and check the original brand release.
